fails_if: `compile_scb_preliminary` retains every row of a paired preliminary edition as support instead of only the rows whose native variable the final edition delivers, so OTHER's preliminary row (CVID 2) leaves the catalog
note: The SCB edition-name rule: a final edition supersedes only the preliminary rows of the native variables it delivers itself, and the preliminary name is matched after trimming its delivered padding.

sources.description: Edition 10 is VALUE's and OTHER's ' 2020, preliminär version ' (padded as delivered); edition 11, the final, delivers only VALUE.
